Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline

src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/init.py

Python · Tier A

Deterministic presentation of actual tool results.

src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/display_document.py

Python · Tier A

Build structured client documents from already normalized result shapes and caller-validated display plans. DisplaySection and DisplayDocument retain source references, ordered rows, column hints, content and preview metadata; build_display_document resolves section sources and deduplicates aliases for implicit plans. Raw availability requires a caller-supplied permission flag, while actual download authorization remains elsewhere. Markdown fallback reconstructs simpler shapes and does not preserve every specialized display option.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
DisplaySection 26 Carry one structured UI section with source identity, content, rows/columns, metadata and preview hints. Unknown top-level fields are forbidden; generated IDs identify presentation sections rather than execution receipts.
DisplayDocument 51 Bundle ordered sections and request/target/summary metadata for a client. raw_available summarizes section hints; this model does not expose an authenticated raw-data endpoint.
build_display_document 141 Build sections from a caller-validated plan or deduplicate supplied source aliases when no sections exist. Carry rows/content/count hints and mark raw availability only when the caller allows it and a shape/record advertises a reference. This neither fetches data nor validates primitive compatibility, redacts content or clips rows.
render_display_document_markdown 216 Render structured sections in order, drop blank blocks and return the fixed empty-result message if none remain. This path reconstructs simple shapes rather than retaining every original specialized renderer.

src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/display_primitives.py

Python · Tier A

Describe the local presentation choices available for normalized tool results. DisplayPrimitiveManifest records accepted shapes/capabilities, renderer names and declarative parameter/safety hints; DisplayPrimitiveRegistry rejects duplicate IDs and resolves compatible choices. The default catalog covers email views, tables, text/code/JSON, scalar/error, debug raw payloads and composite output. Registration does not execute capabilities, and manifests do not themselves enforce access policy or preview limits.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
DisplayPrimitiveManifest 23 Describe accepted shapes/capabilities, renderer parameters and intended preview/safety policy for a presentation primitive. Metadata such as max_preview_rows and safety_policy is declarative; this model does not enforce it.
DisplayPrimitiveManifest.accepts 43 Accept either a recognized shape type or a recognized capability ID. This OR-based compatibility hint does not inspect payload fields or grant execution permissions.
DisplayPrimitiveRegistry 53 Registry of local display primitives, separate from execution capabilities.
DisplayPrimitiveRegistry.register 65 Add one manifest by ID, raising the runtime ValidationError for duplicates so local presentation selection stays unambiguous.
DisplayPrimitiveRegistry.get 79 Resolve a manifest or translate a missing dictionary key into the catalog-backed runtime ValidationError.
DisplayPrimitiveRegistry.list_manifests 92 Return manifests in deterministic registration order.
DisplayPrimitiveRegistry.compatible_manifests 99 Filter manifests using shape-or-capability compatibility in registration order; suppress the composite primitive unless explicitly requested.
build_default_display_primitive_registry 120 Create the fixed email, text/table/code/JSON, scalar/error, debug-raw and composite presentation catalog. Manifest descriptions and schemas are runtime data; selection still requires caller- owned policy and source validation.

src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/models.py

Python · Tier A

Define the plan and rendered-response contracts shared by output renderers. DisplayPlan describes presentation kind, source sections and optional policy hints; RenderedOutput binds the resulting text to its plan and delivery metadata. These Pydantic models reject extra top-level fields while leaving section dictionaries open. They neither authorize source access nor apply redaction/constraints; callers and concrete rendering paths own those decisions.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
DisplayPlan 33 Specify display kind, optional primitive/title, source section dictionaries and presentation constraints/redaction label. Pydantic rejects unknown top-level fields, while section structure and policy enforcement remain caller responsibilities.
RenderedOutput 48 Return rendered content together with the exact DisplayPlan and optional delivery metadata, without persisting output or changing the underlying execution receipt.

src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/redaction.py

Python · Tier A

Compatibility import for the canonical output projection.

src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/renderers.py

Python · Tier A

Render supplied semantic results and display plans as deterministic Markdown/text or structured client documents. Shape dispatch formats command output, tables, aggregates, file previews and email reports; renderer wrappers select text or DisplayDocument delivery. Source lookup and primitive errors propagate, and referenced data is not fetched here. Input projection owns authorization, redaction and most bounds: generic Markdown/JSON formatting neither escapes all syntax nor imposes universal content limits.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
render_email_message_list_result 166 Render message/query/account context and the email evidence table, then append any producer truncation notice and optional heading.
render_email_report_result 206 Render aggregate, grouped or sender analysis with account/query/filter context and its supplied report rows; distinct_count is displayed only when present.
render_email_count_summary_result 229 Show supplied count, account/query context, optional estimate and scan-cap notice. This count- specific renderer reads report truncation rather than deriving totals from messages.
render_email_next_actions_result 250 Show optional draft identity/status and suggested actions with their approval labels. Rendering these rows does not send mail, persist a draft or approve a follow-up.
render_email_thread_result 282 Join supplied thread messages with sender/date and body/body_text/snippet fallback. Body length and number of messages are not bounded by this renderer.
render_email_action_preview_result 300 Present proposed email work and account/query context, with at most 20 batch-unsubscribe groups and two sample subjects per group. Describe mailto, URL or reply-fallback methods without invoking them.
render_email_draft_variants_result 364 Enumerate each supplied draft alternative using tone, subject and body, with a fallback when none exist. No content-length or variant-count limit is applied here.
render_email_automation_report_result 381 Show rule policy and run window/status/candidate facts, then supplied candidate evidence columns. Preview-ready labels are presentation defaults and not completion evidence.
render_email_candidate_review_result 425 Render candidate review text, optional operation and sender/subject/date/reason/confidence rows with inherited truncation metadata.
render_email_rule_summary_result 442 Display available operation, query, semantic filter, approval policy and status from the supplied rule, omitting absent fields.
render_email_pending_approval_result 456 Show the waiting-for-approval message and selected candidate evidence, retaining truncation notices without altering approval state.
render_text_result 469 Render a normalized text result.
render_markdown_result 485 Render trusted runtime-produced markdown.
render_command_output_result 494 Render chosen output as fenced text by default and use a no-output marker only for empty successful exit-code data. Non-code display delegates to the text renderer; original stderr is not appended to nonempty stdout here.
render_table_result 528 Render a normalized table result.
render_record_list_result 535 Render a normalized record-list result.
render_scalar_result 547 Render a normalized scalar result.
render_aggregate_result 556 Render a normalized aggregate result as a scalar-style summary.
render_capability_list_result 576 Render capabilities grouped by domain.
render_error_result 593 Render a normalized error result safely.
render_json_result 602 Serialize the supplied payload as sorted, indented JSON with string fallback and a code fence. The existing docstring's bounded assumption refers to upstream input: this function applies no byte, row or depth limit.
render_multi_section_result 609 Render a multi-section result by rendering each child shape.
render_result_shape 623 Dispatch on the concrete shape class, adapting directory/process/tree rows to record tables and file/command bodies to code blocks. Unknown shapes become text; this layer consumes existing values and does not retrieve referenced payloads.
render_display_plan 760 Resolve plan sections against caller-provided operation/data records and render their shapes. Multi-section plans render all sections; other plans use the first section or first source. Missing sources/primitive IDs raise rather than inventing results; authorization and compatibility validation are caller responsibilities.
OpenWebUIRenderer 839 OpenWebUI-compatible markdown/text renderer.
OpenWebUIRenderer.render 844 Return Markdown/text using the supplied normalized source records. resolve_payload is a retained compatibility argument and is deliberately unused.
LocalAgentUIRenderer 856 Structured DisplayDocument renderer for the local agent UI.
LocalAgentUIRenderer.render 862 Build the structured document through a local import that avoids the renderer/document cycle. Forward the caller's raw-access decision; no extra authorization or payload retrieval happens here.
MarkdownRenderer 886 Compatibility renderer wrapper for older code paths.

src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/result_shapes.py

Python · Tier A

Define semantic result types and the normalization entry point used by deterministic output rendering. Typed text, command, table, file, aggregate and email shapes retain source identity and display hints; normalize_execution_result resolves stored data or a preview and delegates to the ordered adapter registry. Models reject extra top-level fields but do not authorize raw access, enforce size limits or redact secrets. All data comes from supplied execution evidence rather than new tool or model work.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
TextResult 42 Represent a supplied text response for prose or fenced-code rendering; operation identity remains attached to the displayed text.
CommandOutputResult 49 Keep chosen command text alongside original stdout, stderr and exit code so renderers can show useful output without serializing the execution envelope.
MarkdownResult 59 Mark runtime-produced Markdown for direct presentation. The type does not sanitize its contents; callers own content trust and redaction.
TableResult 66 Carry ordered row dictionaries for a table; column selection and textual rendering are separate presentation concerns.
RecordListResult 73 Represent repeated records such as search matches or directory entries without requiring a capability-specific display component.
ScalarResult 80 Present one value with an optional human label and unit. Any value is accepted; this model neither calculates nor verifies it.
AggregateResult 89 Describe an already computed aggregate with its operation, field, unit and considered/used/skipped counts; rendering must not recompute the underlying result.
FileContentResult 103 Associate a supplied content preview with an optional file path. Holding a path does not read the file or grant filesystem access.
DirectoryListingResult 111 Represent directory metadata entries for the dedicated renderer's stable file columns; the default entries adapter currently emits RecordListResult instead.
FileTreeResult 119 Carry supplied tree-node dictionaries and their root path for presentation; nodes are displayed as records rather than traversing a live filesystem.
ProcessListResult 127 Attach an optional search pattern to process records already collected by an execution capability; no process polling occurs here.
CapabilityListResult 135 Carry domain-grouped capability descriptions, optional flat records and a supplied count. The Markdown renderer uses the grouped mapping.
ErrorResult 144 Carry a displayable failure message after upstream projection/normalization. The schema itself does not strip tracebacks or secrets.
JsonResult 151 Keep an arbitrary structured payload for JSON inspection when no more specific semantic shape applies; serialization and size bounds belong to other layers.
EmailMessageListResult 158 Pair email message summaries with semantic match evidence and the interpreted query for inbox- style or Markdown output.
EmailAggregateResult 167 Represent distinct-value or distinct-count email analysis with its supplied report, rows, summary and query; no mailbox calculation runs in this model.
EmailCountSummaryResult 177 Keep a count report separate from repeated messages so renderers can expose account/query context and scan-limit uncertainty.
EmailGroupedReportResult 186 Carry email analysis grouped by a dimension other than the dedicated sender family, retaining report metadata and display rows.
EmailSenderReportResult 196 Identify sender, sender-domain or brand analysis for specialized presentation while retaining the common report/rows/query contract.
EmailNextActionsResult 206 Present terminal email next-step guidance and optional draft/action metadata; these suggestions do not execute or approve an action.
EmailThreadResult 215 Bundle supplied thread metadata and selected message bodies for conversation rendering; callers must bound and authorize the message content.
EmailActionPreviewResult 223 Describe a proposed email operation, candidate messages, match evidence and approval context without performing the mutation.
EmailDraftVariantsResult 235 Carry generated draft alternatives and selection context for presentation. This shape alone neither persists drafts nor enforces their retention policy.
EmailAutomationReportResult 244 Present automation rule/run evidence, candidates and operation/query context without implying that previewed work has executed.
EmailCandidateReviewResult 255 Group automation candidates with an operation and review message for an explicit approval/rejection surface.
EmailRuleSummaryResult 264 Expose a supplied automation rule and explanatory message as a compact display shape; rule validation and storage remain elsewhere.
EmailPendingApprovalResult 272 Represent retained approval context and its selected candidates without granting approval or changing workflow state.
MultiSectionResult 281 Combine non-composite result shapes under one source identity/title. The forward-referenced child union is rebuilt after all classes are declared and excludes nested MultiSectionResult values.
normalize_execution_result 426 Resolve payload/title/capability metadata and dispatch through a fresh default adapter registry. The local import breaks the shapes/adapters dependency cycle; adapter coercion and validation failures propagate. No model call or tool execution occurs.

src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/shape_adapters.py

Python · Tier A

Convert existing execution payloads into semantic result shapes using ordered local rules. ShapeAdapter matches status, capability, payload keys and custom predicates; ShapeAdapterRegistry selects the first rule by priority and ID. Specialized email/capability projections precede generic rows, values, command output, JSON and text fallbacks. Callbacks copy display context and preserve available count hints, but do not execute actions, enforce consent or fetch provider data. Invalid coercions and callback failures propagate to the caller.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ShapeAdapterContext 54 Bind an execution receipt to its resolved payload, capability ID and optional title for one normalization pass. The frozen wrapper does not make nested payload data immutable.
ShapeAdapter 71 Declare status/capability/key predicates plus an optional matcher and normalization callback. output_shape_type describes the rule but is not runtime validation of the callback's return value.
ShapeAdapter.matches 85 Require every configured status, capability and payload-key condition before evaluating the optional matcher; an empty status tuple permits any status. Matcher exceptions propagate.
ShapeAdapterRegistry 108 Evaluate adapters in priority/ID order and invoke the first match. Registry methods retain callbacks in memory and perform no IO, authorization or execution replay.
ShapeAdapterRegistry.register 115 Append a rule and sort by ascending priority then adapter_id. Equal-priority rules are ordered by ID rather than insertion; duplicate IDs are not rejected here.
ShapeAdapterRegistry.list_adapters 121 Return adapters in evaluation order.
ShapeAdapterRegistry.select_adapter 128 Return the first matching rule or raise the catalog-backed ValueError when a custom registry has no match. The default registry ends with an unconditional text fallback.
ShapeAdapterRegistry.normalize 140 Normalize a context using the first matching adapter.
_email_analysis_result 397 Select aggregate/sender/grouped report form, copy dictionary rows and retain account/query/filter metadata. Carry the first supported analysis/CSV/table export descriptor under compatibility aliases; this does not create an export.
build_default_shape_adapter_registry 905 Install error/skipped handling, specialized capability/email rules, generic keyed payload rules and final text fallback. Most rules accept success only; command and unknown-dictionary rules also accept completed. Sorting uses priority then ID, so a matching message rule precedes command output.

src/agent_runtime/output_pipeline/table_export.py

Python · Tier A

Serialize supplied row dictionaries into CSV and optionally write a workspace export. table_columns preserves explicit or first-seen column order, rows_to_csv_text formats cells, and write_csv_artifact returns file metadata after writing UTF-8 bytes. Directory creation and writes are the only external effects; IO errors propagate. Export paths, privacy, spreadsheet interpretation and collisions are caller concerns, and this helper does not register an immutable artifact version.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
table_columns 66 Use explicit nonempty column order verbatim, otherwise discover the first-seen union of stringified row keys. Missing cells later become blank and unspecified columns are omitted.
rows_to_csv_text 82 Copy dictionary rows, compute stable headers and serialize through csv.DictWriter with CRLF records and extra fields ignored. Return an in-memory string; CSV quoting does not neutralize spreadsheet formulas.
write_csv_artifact 99 Create the configured output directory and write UTF-8 CSV using a sanitized prefix plus a UTC second-resolution timestamp. Same-prefix writes within one second can overwrite. Return path/count/column/size/privacy metadata, not a registered immutable artifact; IO errors propagate and callers own path/privacy policy.
